parameters.query:
WITH cl AS (SELECT bot_id FROM clients WHERE bot_type IN ('client','trusted')),
 reg AS (SELECT cp.bot_id, cp.user_id, cp.sex, cp.onboarding_done, cp.created_at FROM client_profile cp WHERE cp.bot_id IN (SELECT bot_id FROM cl)),
 act AS (SELECT r.bot_id, r.user_id FROM reg r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n8n_chat_histories h WHERE h.session_id=r.bot_id||':'||r.user_id AND h.created_at >= now()-interval '7 days' AND h.message->>'type'='human'))
SELECT json_build_object(
 'registered',(SELECT count(*) FROM reg),
 'new7',(SELECT count(*) FROM reg WHERE created_at >= now()-interval '7 days'),
 'onboarded',(SELECT count(*) FROM reg WHERE onboarding_done),
 'male',(SELECT count(*) FROM reg WHERE sex='male'),
 'female',(SELECT count(*) FROM reg WHERE sex='female'),
 'sex_unknown',(SELECT count(*) FROM reg WHERE sex IS NULL OR sex NOT IN ('male','female')),
 'active7',(SELECT count(*) FROM act),
 'active_male',(SELECT count(*) FROM act a JOIN reg r ON r.bot_id=a.bot_id AND r.user_id=a.user_id WHERE r.sex='male'),
 'active_female',(SELECT count(*) FROM act a JOIN reg r ON r.bot_id=a.bot_id AND r.user_id=a.user_id WHERE r.sex='female'),
 'feat_workout',(SELECT count(DISTINCT (bot_id||':'||user_id)) FROM workout_session WHERE performed_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date AND bot_id IN (SELECT bot_id FROM cl)),
 'feat_food',(SELECT count(DISTINCT (bot_id||':'||user_id)) FROM food_log WHERE eaten_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date AND bot_id IN (SELECT bot_id FROM cl)),
 'feat_meas',(SELECT count(DISTINCT (bot_id||':'||user_id)) FROM measurement WHERE measured_on >= (now()-interval '7 days')::date AND bot_id IN (SELECT bot_id FROM cl)),
 'feat_research',(SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) FROM research_attempts WHERE created_at >= now()-interval '7 days' AND bot_id IN (SELECT bot_id FROM cl)),
 'feat_recipe',(SELECT count(DISTINCT (bot_id||':'||user_id)) FROM recipe WHERE created_at >= now()-interval '7 days' AND bot_id IN (SELECT bot_id FROM cl)),
 'feat_voice',(SELECT count(DISTINCT (bot_id||':'||user_id)) FROM usage_event WHERE feature='voice' AND at >= now()-interval '7 days' AND bot_id IN (SELECT bot_id FROM cl)),
 'feat_photo',(SELECT count(DISTINCT (bot_id||':'||user_id)) FROM usage_event WHERE feature='photo' AND at >= now()-interval '7 days' AND bot_id IN (SELECT bot_id FROM cl)),
 'feat_document',(SELECT count(DISTINCT (bot_id||':'||user_id)) FROM usage_event WHERE feature='document' AND at >= now()-interval '7 days' AND bot_id IN (SELECT bot_id FROM cl))
) AS report;
